response.body: The inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear shall be provided and maintained wherever this procedure applies, and its condition shall be treated as a critical control. This clause applies to activities archived under LIFTING-AND-SUSPENDED-LOADS at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop.
